rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Generates nine types of Korean employment contracts compliant with 2026 minimum wage standards and court precedents, outputting in .txt and .docx formats. Protects sensitive data by masking names, IDs, and addresses before sending to Claude, then restoring values in the final output. Built with Python and Apache 2.0 license, targeting Korean business compliance workflows.
